verdict.rationale: Portkey's docs say budget and rate limits are configured on individual API keys. Budget limits cap spend or tokens and automatically block further usage when reached, rate limits can be set per minute, hour or day, and there are periodic resets and threshold alerts. An agent given its own key therefore cannot run away on spend. Missing for 10: explicit docs on minting a dedicated key for an agent (e.g., programmatic key creation), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the limits are enforced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can give an autonomous agent its own key with budget and rate guardrails so it cannot run away on spend

citations.quote: Configure budget and rate limits on API keys to effectively manage AI spending and usage across your organization
Budget limits allow you to set maximum LLM spending or token usage thresholds on your API keys, automatically preventing further usage when limits are reached.
Set hourly, daily, or per minute rate limits on requests or tokens sent
**Reset Weekly**: Budget limits reset every Sunday at 12 AM UTC
When usage reaches this threshold, notifications will be sent to configured recipients
